reason: A macOS desktop utility that uses local camera-based hand gestures to control the cursor and mouse actions through a DSH plugin and Swift Vision helper.

summaries.zh: 通过本地摄像头手势识别控制 macOS 光标、点击、拖拽和滚动的 DSH 插件。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin that uses local camera-based hand gestures to control the macOS cursor, clicking, dragging, and scrolling.

capabilities: Reads camera frames locally for hand-gesture recognition
Synthesizes macOS mouse events through Accessibility/PostEvent permissions
Starts and stops a local Swift vision helper through authenticated IPC
Routes explicitly enabled special gestures to deterministic plugin actions or plans
